name: Option Style 4 Code
definition: Defines how an option can be exercised.

AMER.name: American
AMER.definition: Option can be exercised before or on expiry date.

EURO.name: European
EURO.definition: Option that can be exercised on expiry date only.

BERM.name: Bermudan
BERM.definition: Option that can be exercised on multiple discrete dates prior to, or on expiry date.
